The only '247' parcel matches are BD 247 in rows a* and d of the voirie creation/amélioration table, which refer to section BD, not CR (c-02)[BD 3, 13, 14, 206, 227, 247 in row a*; BD 206, 247, 21, 211, 18, 43 in row d].
